name: Create an archive asset record
title: Create an archive asset record
description:
Index a recording or evidence asset against its camera and, where applicable, Motion Event and ingest batch. Record the capture window, media type, byte size, storage backend, retention state, and a SHA-256 checksum when available/required. For Frappe File storage attach the approved file; for external storage, use the configured scope/reference and never expose a private URL.

Check that capture start is not after capture end, the camera/event association is correct, and the checksum describes the exact stored bytes. The index status is managed by the indexing workflow—do not mark an unverified asset complete by hand.
